# The writing domain

Scripts, copy and captions of a production: revisions, network limits, duration estimate, drafts by a model.

## How to reach it

MCP tools: `command_help`, `job_start`, `project_item`. Tools that take `domain=writing`: `command_help`.

CLI: `stuarty writing` lists the commands of the domain and `stuarty writing <verb>` runs one; the full names stay valid.

- `text:list`: list the scripts, copy and captions of a project, or of every project
- `text:show`: show a text, or one of its revisions
- `text:write`: make a text, or save a new revision of one, from a Markdown file
- `text:revisions`: list the revisions of a text, and compare two by paragraph
- `text:revert`: bring an older revision of a text back as a new revision
- `text:draft`: ask a model for a draft of a text; the job shows its estimate and waits for approval
- `caption:validate`: measure a caption against the limits of each network
- `script:estimate`: estimate how long a script takes when read aloud

## Operations

No edit operations yet. The domain is reached through the tools and commands above; operations that a later epic registers in it appear here, and `command_help domain=writing` lists them.
